description: This file defines a Builder class responsible for building and organizing a content tree structure for documentation or similar hierarchical content management. It includes methods for ignoring specific files/directories, creating content nodes, sorting, and finalizing the tree with next/previous links.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A class with static methods to build and organize a hierarchical content tree from filesystem directories and files, handling content types, naming, sorting, and navigation links.

methods.name: isIgnored
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory should be ignored based on predefined ignored paths or ignore rules.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Extracts the filename without extension from a given path.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Recursively builds the content tree from a directory node, creating Directory or Content/Raw objects for files and subdirectories.

methods.name: createContent
methods.description: Creates a content node for a file, deciding between Content, Raw, or ComputedRaw based on the file extension and config.

methods.name: removeSortingInformations
methods.description: Removes numeric sorting prefixes from filenames to produce a clean name for display or URL purposes.

methods.name: getOrCreateDir
methods.description: Retrieves an existing directory node with the given title under the parent or creates a new Directory node.

methods.name: getOrCreatePage
methods.description: Retrieves an existing page node with the given path under the parent or creates a new Content or ComputedRaw node based on extension and config.

methods.name: sortTree
methods.description: Recursively sorts the directory nodes and their entries.

methods.name: finalizeTree
methods.description: Assigns next and previous links among content pages for navigation.
